footer.tagline: Autonomous sales intelligence for revenue teams who don't have time to go looking for the signal — only to act on it.

landing.heroTitle: Autonomous sales intelligence that decides <hl>in real time.</hl>
landing.heroSubtitle: BEE watches the market, prioritizes your pipeline, and prepares your next move while you close — no friction, no fabricated data, never losing control of a single decision.
landing.demoTitle: From signal to opportunity — explore the dashboard yourself.
landing.guaranteesSubtitle: Not promises — architectural guarantees behind every decision BEE makes on your behalf.

noHallucinations.title: Zero hallucinations
noHallucinations.description: Every score and every metric comes from real data. When there's no data, the system shows empty — it never invents one.

humanApproval.title: Human approval, always
humanApproval.description: No external action — an email, a message, a sequence — ever fires without explicit go-ahead.

multiTenant.title: Real multi-tenancy
multiTenant.description: Strict data isolation per organization, end to end — not an optional flag.

secureByDesign.title: Secure by design
secureByDesign.description: HMAC-signed webhooks and per-environment secrets — credentials never touch the codebase.

landing.closingTitle: Your next customer is already sending signals. The question is whether you're seeing them.
